description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseStore class, which implements the Store interface for persisting monitoring metrics into a database within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for flushing monitor data to the database, constructing SQL insert statements based on metric types.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: Implements the Store interface to save monitoring metrics into a database, used within SuiteCRM's tracking system.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Saves monitor metrics into the database by constructing and executing an SQL INSERT statement based on the metrics' types and values.
